notes.title: Buy a Game, Help Kids Beat Cancer
notes.notes:
Aspyr is proud to announce that we, along with several other publishers, have joined forced with Team17 and GOSH -- Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity -- in their efforts to raise money to build a new Children's Care Center at the GOSH Hospital based in London.

As well as being one of the world's leading children's hospitals, the Great Ormond Street Hospital is the largest for children's heart surgery in Britain and one of the largest for heart transplants in the world. Fun fact: the hospital owns the copyright to Peter Pan. Who knew?

GOSH is running the Play it. Build it. Beat it. sale on Steam until 2/24 and Aspyr is donating ːgetreadyː 100% of its proceeds ːgetreadyː from Heads Up sales during this event to the hospital. The other publishers involved have also pledged to donate a portion of their proceeds to this organization. The sale is chock-full of cozy and co-op games, so buy some games to play with your buds. And make them buy games too. Hey, it's for the kids!

Some highlights from the Aspyr team:
[list]
[*] The Cult of the Lamb
[*] Overcooked series
[*] Cat Quest
[*] Little Kitty Big City
[*] The Past Within 
[*] Heads Up! Phones Down Edition ːyouwinː
[/list]

Heads Up! Phones Down Edition is on sale now for a cool $1.99 and is tons of fun to play with your friends or family -- snag yourself a copy: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2533370/Heads_Up_Phones_Down_Edition/

And check out the rest of the sale out here!

notes.title: Heads Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Build Your Own Deck is Here[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742800/b343c3983809310f6f65da2469588a65fef712d5.png[/img]

Have you ever played Heads Up and thought, “I could write a better deck?”

Well, that hurts a bit, BUT NOW YOU CAN with our newly launched, Build Your Own deck feature.

Here are some thought starters:
[list]
[*] Worst TikTok Trends
[*] Literal Rocket Science
[*] Disgraced Celebrities
[*] Basic Quantum Physics Algorithms
[*] Regrettable Tattoos
[*] The Meaning of Life
[*] Terrible Pick-Up Lines
[/list]
With Build Your Own Deck, please behave. ːgetreadyː

[h2]90 Decks and Nothing to Play? Try Random Deck![/h2]

The 90’s were great. 

So we have 90 decks. 

That’s why we did that. 

Yes, I promise. 

Why are you asking such aggressive questions?

[h3]Introducing...[b][i]Random Deck!!![/i][/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742800/1be5d2a8186df6a4b7d946acfe294de659f11ee0.png[/img]

[i](shimmering sound FX) [/i][EMOJIS] [MORE EMOJIS]

Random Deck likes long walks on the beach, hip hop, numbers and letters, dogs…and cats…Wait Random Deck are you just giving me random deck names?!

With Random Deck, the world is your [i]slurp[/i], oyster it up! You’ll never know what to expect, unless you’ve already memorized every deck, in which case you’re a really hardcore player and I’m scared. 

[spoiler]I'd like to go home now.[/spoiler]

[h2]And here’s a preview of our ✨invite-only✨ Twitch Extension.[/h2]

Streamers! Contact pr@aspyr.com for early access.

Your favorite party game just partied a little harder! We’re excited to announce (and more excited to play) our new Twitch Extension for Heads Up! Phones Down Edition.

Here’s how it works!

[h3]Streamer Guesses:[/h3]

Streamers, you’re up! In Streamer Guesses mode, the word you’re gonna want to guess is shown in-stream to your audience and kept secret from you. Now just wait for your viewers to type their clues into chat and (poorly) guess away!

Don’t worry, we’ve already thought about the elephant in the room – the correct word is automatically blocked in chat to prevent your audience from straight up telling you the answer. Don’t cheat.[spoiler]You know what happens to cheaters, don’t you? [/spoiler]
[quote=Aspyr]HOT TIP: Disable the Show Moderator Actions in your chat settings by clicking the gear icon located below your chatbox. [/quote]
Once you guess the word correctly, you can either advance to the next word through in-game controls or have your [strike]minions[/strike] moderators use the !advance_word chat feature.

Here’s what your audience will see in Streamer Guesses mode: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742800/3e34b90e3ee26553ca3ac6723d3460f44ffc24c6.png[/img]
[h3]Chat Guesses:[/h3]

If you guessed that in Chat Guesses mode, your chat guesses while you give out clues, you guessed right! Good for you. ːyouwinː

If you guessed literally anything else, you ought to be ashamed of yourself.

[i]It’s pretty self-explanatory, but I’ll explain it anyway.[/i] In Chat Guesses mode, the word to be guessed is shown to you (the Streamer) via the chatbot window in your browser. 

It’s up to you to act out the words or give clues while your chat guesses. Simple, right?
[quote=Aspyr] HOTTER TIP: Enable our little chatbot friend! It’ll automatically detect correct guesses in your chat.[/quote]
[quote=Aspyr]HOTTEST TIP: With the Auto-Advance Chat feature enabled, a correct guess automatically advances the game to the next word. [/quote]

When time’s up, viewers who guessed correctly are displayed on the scorecard – neat! ːSTBHandː

Here’s what your stream will look like to your viewers in Chat Guesses mode:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742800/c902cff7056cbefae532d0a312d9c998251ef1ab.png[/img]
 
For information and early access, reach out to pr@aspyr.com


[h1]Are you still reading? Have you ever thought about writing…a review?[/h1]

Thank you for reading these patch notes! We’d love to hear your thoughts about Heads Up in the Steam Reviews.

Steam Reviews let us know what you think of the game, and we use that feedback to shape what’s next. If you haven’t written a review for Heads Up, please consider letting us know your thoughts.

Thank you for your kind words. Unless they’re unkind, in which case, [spoiler]@#!^$( &$&@&#$( @!&#@*$&!!!![/spoiler]
